name: Air
overview: Scripture reveals that air is part of God's created order, encompassing the heavens and the earth He made at the beginning (Genesis 1:1). It sustains life and is the domain of various creatures, including birds described as 'fowls of the air' (Acts 10:12). The air also symbolizes the invisible forces of nature, as seen in the destructive winds that can bring judgment (Matthew 7:27). Furthermore, the Spirit's work, often associated with air or breath, brings spiritual life and unity among believers, exemplified at Pentecost and in the quickening of those dead in sin (Acts 2:1; Ephesians 2:1).
